# Shelf Light Selection Starts with the Shelf

A magnetic light bar needs a compatible ferromagnetic mounting surface. If the shelf is timber, glass, or non-ferrous metal, the mounting method has to change before fixture selection begins.

Power layout is the second constraint. A movable fixture is useful only when its connection can move with it while voltage and load remain within the product documentation.

Check the shelf material and power route first. Those two facts determine whether magnetic mounting is suitable for the project.
